title: Hooks and Callbacks
summary: This module provides a flexible system for defining and managing hooks and callbacks that execute before or after LLM and tool calls, allowing for custom logic, logging, and intervention.

nodes.label: Clear All Global Hooks
nodes.title: Clear All Global Hooks
nodes.description: A utility function to clear all registered global hooks for both LLM and tool calls, useful for resetting the system state.

nodes.label: Hook Decorator Factory
nodes.title: Hook Decorator Factory
nodes.description: A factory function that generates decorators for registering hooks, supporting filtering by tools and agents.

nodes.label: Before LLM Call Hook
nodes.title: Before LLM Call Hook
nodes.description: A decorator to register functions that execute before an LLM call, allowing for pre-processing or logging.

nodes.label: After LLM Call Hook
nodes.title: After LLM Call Hook
nodes.description: A decorator to register functions that execute after an LLM call, enabling post-processing, response modification, or logging.

nodes.label: Before Tool Call Hook
nodes.title: Before Tool Call Hook
nodes.description: A decorator to register functions that execute before a tool call, useful for validation, approval flows, or logging.

nodes.label: After Tool Call Hook
nodes.title: After Tool Call Hook
nodes.description: A decorator to register functions that execute after a tool call, allowing for result processing, sanitization, or logging.

nodes.label: Before LLM Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.title: Before LLM Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods intended as 'before LLM call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling their detection and registration.

nodes.label: After LLM Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.title: After LLM Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods intended as 'after LLM call' hooks within CrewBase classes, facilitating their registration and execution.

nodes.label: Before Tool Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.title: Before Tool Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods intended as 'before tool call' hooks within CrewBase classes, allowing for proper registration and filtering.

nodes.label: After Tool Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.title: After Tool Call Hook Method Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps methods intended as 'after tool call' hooks within CrewBase classes, ensuring their correct registration and execution.

groups.label: Hook Registration
groups.title: Hook Registration
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and registering various types of hooks that can be triggered during LLM and tool interactions.

groups.label: Hook Management
groups.title: Hook Management
groups.description: Utilities for managing the lifecycle of registered hooks, such as clearing them.

groups.label: Hook Method Wrappers
groups.title: Hook Method Wrappers
groups.description: Classes that wrap methods to enable their use as hooks within CrewBase classes, providing context and filtering capabilities.
